task: Add optional `locked?: boolean` to BoardShape in src/board/useShapes.ts. Create src/board/lockGuard.ts exporting `export function isLocked(item: { locked?: boolean }): boolean { return item.locked === true }`. Then import isLocked in useShapes.ts and use it inside reorderShapes so that ids belonging to a locked shape are dropped from the set passed to reorder().

steps.goal: Create lockGuard module with isLocked helper.
steps.edit_spec: Create the file containing exactly: export function isLocked(item: { locked?: boolean }): boolean { return item.locked === true }

acceptance_check.cmd: if ((Select-String -Path src/board/lockGuard.ts -SimpleMatch 'export function isLocked') -and (Select-String -Path src/board/lockGuard.ts -SimpleMatch 'item.locked === true')) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

steps.goal: Add locked field to BoardShape and import isLocked in useShapes.ts.
steps.edit_spec: In src/board/useShapes.ts, add the import line import { isLocked } from './lockGuard'; after the existing top-level imports. In the BoardShape type/interface declaration, insert a new optional member locked?: boolean; immediately before its closing brace.

acceptance_check.cmd: if ((Select-String -Path src/board/useShapes.ts -SimpleMatch 'locked?: boolean') -and (Select-String -Path src/board/useShapes.ts -Pattern 'isLocked.*from.*lockGuard')) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

steps.goal: Filter locked shape ids out of the set passed to reorder() inside reorderShapes.
steps.edit_spec: Inside reorderShapes in src/board/useShapes.ts, change the value passed to reorder() so locked shapes are excluded. Use the existing local array of BoardShape items available in reorderShapes (often named shapes, items, or boardShapes). If a Set is built from shape objects, replace it with new Set(<shapes>.filter((s) => !isLocked(s)).map((s) => s.id)) using the actual collection name and id property. If a Set is built from an incoming id array, add const lockedIds = new Set(<shapes>.filter(isLocked).map((s) => s.id)); before the reorder call and pass new Set(ids.filter((id) => !lockedIds.has(id))) to reorder(). Keep the filter expression on one line so it contains both filter and isLocked.

acceptance_check.cmd: if ((Select-String -Path src/board/useShapes.ts -Pattern 'filter.*isLocked') -and (Select-String -Path src/board/useShapes.ts -Pattern 'reorder\s*\(')) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
